readCookie returns the raw cookie value without decodeURIComponent, but res.cookie() URL-encodes values ("/notes" is stored as "%2Fnotes"); safePath then rejects it because it no longer starts with "/", so the callback always redirects to /profile instead of the page the user came from.
The token-exchange fetch to GitHub has no AbortSignal/timeout, so a slow or hung upstream holds the callback request open indefinitely.
The profile fetch to the GitHub API has no timeout, so a hung upstream connection stalls the login callback indefinitely.
